# Final Places365 fallback corpus

The12 newly sourced originals in `sources.json` are all final held-out material for Places365, regardless of the downloader's alternating split metadata. The authoritative split/labels are in `benchmark.json`:12 reused development/calibration originals from TinyCLIP's calibration set, followed by these12 disjoint new held-out originals. TinyCLIP's test set is not reused for fallback calibration. The source response, author HTML, license/URL, byte count and SHA-256 accompany each file. One jewelry query returned no suitable JPEG and was replaced by a same-subject query before annotation/inference; all earlier selections were retained. The watch query returned an insect macro; it was retained as an unsupported example rather than removed.

Native Places365 label strings are unchanged; multiple acceptable scene labels are listed where applicable. Single visual annotator, sparse coverage, closeups/art/manuscript challenges and convenience sampling prevent general/class-level reliability claims. No model output guided held-out selection or annotation. Preserve original author attribution and recorded CC BY/CC BY-SA/public-domain declarations; share-alike terms remain applicable. Images are research-only and never included in release assets.
